lauren: Heads-up: a user just hit our quickstart and got a vague error: 'Authentication failed' with no code or retry guidance. they're blocked during onboarding.
kevin: which quickstart? go or js?
lauren: go quickstart CLI. it prints the raw http body. js SDK returns a structured error object, so parity is off.
chris: not surprised. we've been inconsistent about the error contract. we should have a single platform error shape.
mia: agreed. propose splitting fields: short user-facing message, a programmatic code, an error type, http status, and optional retry metadata/hint.
kevin: sketch of the contract: type=AuthError, code=unauthorized, status=401, message="Invalid API key", retryable=false, hint="verify API_KEY env var"
chris: for rate limits: type=RateLimitError, code=rate_limit, status=429, message="Too many requests", retry_after=12, retryable=true
lauren: can we include a tiny `hint` field that sample apps can surface to help new users? e.g., "Check your project API key in Settings -> API"
mia: prefer concision: `hint` should be short and action-oriented. also add `scope` when helpful (token vs project).
kevin: SDK mapping table idea: 401->AuthError, 403->PermissionError, 404->NotFoundError, 409->ConflictError, 429->RateLimitError, 5xx->TransientError, else->APIError. all should inherit from APIError base.
chris: +1. also include `internal_code` (opaque) for platform debug logs, but mark it non-user-facing.
lauren: product note: the console should never show raw internal messages. if `hint` is missing, fall back to friendly copy like "We couldn't sign you in. Check your API key."
kevin: implementation plan: update go quickstart to parse the new shape, display hint when present, otherwise show fallback. keep raw body available via `--debug`.
mia: tests: add small harness in sampleapp that triggers 401, 429, 500 and asserts SDK raises the right typed exception with fields: type, code, status, retryable, hint.
chris: also proposing a CI linter that validates error shapes from staging endpoints so regressions are caught early. I can add a smoke-test check.
ops-bot: deploy #staging completed: infra-service v3.4.1 - feature-flag `error-formatter` enabled on staging
lauren: ideal timing. kevin, can you do a tiny PR to the go quickstart to consume the new shape and update CLI output? this should reduce onboarding tickets.
kevin: yep, i'll add minimal parsing and fallback UX, update changelog, and include a test.
lauren: can someone land the HTTP->typed-exception mapping doc in the devex repo today so SDK owners can follow?
mia: i'll draft the mapping doc + a short SDK checklist (fields to expose, user_message helper, tests) and post in #devex by EOD. :rocket:
kevin: tagged chris for CI linter work once the doc posts.
chris: i'll implement the smoke-test linter change after doc lands.
lauren: i'll open a meta-issue linking the quickstart PR, the mapping doc, and the CI linter under one milestone.
kevin: +1
mia: +1
chris: +1
lauren: thanks all, this should make onboarding much smoother.
